 Syria sets first-term exam dates and mid-year break for 2026-2027
 Published: 2026/11/18 2:50 PM 
 Updated: 2026/11/18 2:50 PM 
 The headquarters of Syria's Ministry of Education in Damascus. File Photo: SANA 
 Damascus, Nov. 18 (SANA) The Ministry of Education has set the dates for first-term examinations and the mid-year school holiday for the 2026-2027 academic year, according to a circular sent to education directorates across Syria’s provinces.
In a statement published on its Telegram channel on Wednesday, the ministry said first-term examinations will begin on Sunday, Jan. 3, 2027, and end on Tuesday, Jan. 12.
The mid-year holiday will start on Wednesday, Jan. 13, and continue through Thursday, Jan. 21, the circular said.
The 2026-2027 academic year began on Sept. 6, with classes resuming at public and private schools and equivalent educational institutions across the country.
